heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Flat gauge glasses are often preferred because:

options.B: A light can be installed in front of them
options.E: It is easier to see the level

explanation: Flat gauge glasses use heavy glass plates and robust metal frames, allowing them to safely withstand much higher operating pressures than tubular glass.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: ASME sect 1 requires the lowest visible water level in a gage glass to be at least ____ above the lowest permissible water level.
explanation: According to ASME Section I (power boilers), the lowest visible water level in the gauge glass must be at least 50 mm (2 inches) above the lowest permissible water level of the boiler.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Gauge glasses show a water level which is:

options.A: Slightly lower when the glass water density is higher
options.B: The actual vessel level regardless of pressure, temperature or density differences
options.C: Slightly less than the level if the vessel is at a lower temperature
options.D: Slightly higher than boiler level when the pressure is high
options.E: The same if all liquids have the same temperature

explanation: The water in an external gauge glass cools down slightly compared to the high-temperature water inside the boiler drum, resulting in a higher density and causing the gauge glass to show a level slightly lower than the actual internal drum level.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: The quick closing valves on a water gauge glass requires _____ turn to change from open to closed.
explanation: Quick-closing gauge glass shutoff valves are designed to operate with a 90-degree (quarter turn) movement from fully open to fully closed.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: ASME section 1 requires the connections from water column to a boiler to be:
explanation: ASME Section I specifies a minimum pipe size of 25 mm (1 inch) for connections between the boiler and the water column to prevent blockage by scale and sludge.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: ASME sect IV requires the lowest visible part of the gage glass to be at least ____ above the lowest permissible water level.
explanation: For heating boilers under ASME Section IV, the lowest visible water level in the glass must be at least 25 mm (1 inch) above the lowest permissible water level.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Try cocks are:

options.A: For checking water level while the gauge glass is out of service
options.C: Used to blowdown the gage glass
options.D: On the water column drain line

explanation: Try cocks are direct mechanical sample valves mounted on the water column to verify boiler water level independently if the gauge glass is broken, isolated, or out of service.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Low water fuel cut off is used to:

options.A: Shut off the air when there is a low water level
options.B: Shut off the water when there is a low water level
options.C: Shut off fuel when there is a low air level
options.D: Shut off the fuel when there is a low water level
options.E: Shut off the water when there is a low fuel pressure

explanation: A low-water fuel cut-off (LWFC) device immediately de-energizes the burner fuel valves when boiler water drops below safe operating limits to prevent overheating and boiler damage.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Separately mounted gauge glasses are used to provide a __________ indication of level over a certain vertical distance on the vessel.
explanation: Multiple gauge glasses mounted with overlapping visible ranges are used on tall vessels to provide continuous visual tracking of liquid level across a wide vertical span.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: When the main operating element is a large diaphragm, the water level indicator is a:
explanation: Remote liquid level indicators (such as Hopkinson types) often use a large diaphragm capsule sensing differential pressure to actuate the remote pointer.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Most low water cut off are:
explanation: The majority of industrial low-water fuel cut-offs utilize float mechanisms or probes (electrode types) to sense water level changes directly.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: CSA requirements state that boilers that are not under continuous supervision by a licensed power engineer must:

options.B: Have two dependent low water cut offs
options.C: Have at least two low water fuel cut off devices
options.D: Must have no shut off devices that can be tested
options.E: Be shut down and automatic controls installed

explanation: Unattended or automatically supervised boiler standards (such as CSA B51) mandate the installation of at least two independent low-water fuel cut-off devices.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: If a gauge glass breaks, the operator shall immediately:

options.D: Shut off the steam valve and water valve on the gauge
options.E: Add more water to the boiler

explanation: When a gauge glass shatters, the immediate priority is to close the gauge glass steam and water shutoff valves to prevent uncontrolled steam and water discharge.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Each steam heating boiler gauge glass shall be fitted with a drain cock or valve having an unrestricted drain opening of not less than ____ diameter to facilitate cleaning.
explanation: Gauge glass drain connections must have an unrestricted opening of at least 6 mm (1/4 inch) to ensure effective blowing down and clearing of scale or sludge.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Dirt traps are installed on remote water-level indicator:

options.C: To prevent mixing of the indicating liquid with boiler water
options.D: Because of the high amount of suspended solids collecting in the constant head
options.E: So that overfilling of the indicating section is prevented

explanation: Dirt traps are installed on remote water-level indicators to catch dirt, rust, scale, and other suspended impurities before they enter and contaminate the indicating liquid. Keeping the indicating liquid clean helps maintain accurate and reliable water-level readings.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: When two Low Water Fuel Cut Offs are used, the lower of the two controls shall:

options.B: Cause a safety shutdown and lockout
options.C: Cause the feedwater valve to go wide open

explanation: In dual low-water fuel cut-off setups, the secondary (lower) cut-off acts as a failsafe backup that initiates a hard safety lockout shutdown.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Tubular gauge glasses:

options.A: Are suitable for pressures up to 3000 kPa
options.E: Do not corrode due to high alkalinity

explanation: Tubular gauge glasses have lower pressure structural limits and are typically restricted to lower pressures (usually up to 2000–3000 kPa depending on specific code allowances).

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Gauge glass failures often occur due to:

options.A: Failure to heat the glass gradually

explanation: Thermal shock caused by turning on steam valves too quickly without gradually preheating the glass is a primary cause of gauge glass fracture.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: A water gauge shall be fitted with rods or chains so it can be operated from the floor or working platform when it is _____ from the floor.
explanation: When water gauges are located high above the operating floor (typically over 6 meters), operating chains or extension rods must be provided so operators can manipulate the valves safely from below.

heading: Water Level Safety Controls
question: Boilers that require two Low Water Fuel Cutoff devices:

options.A: Must ensure each is installed in individual float chambers
options.B: Can use both as combination level control/LWFCO devices
options.C: Can save space by installing both in a single column
options.D: Must use only electrode type devices
options.E: Must have full time operators present

explanation: To ensure absolute reliability and prevent a single obstruction or failure from disabling both cut-offs, dual LWFC units must be installed in separate float chambers or independent tappings.
